A: **Two models: Demo Line vs Fix Circles.** Line: electrician fixes while all watch. Circles: 3 tables of 4 chairs sorted by fault — no-power, intermittent, mechanical. Electrician spends 20 min per table; visitors attempt neighbor's device with cue cards. Example: Maya brought a dead kettle, helps diagnose Tran's dead lamp, learns fuse testing she never needed. Test: next week give each returner a foreign broken item; Circles should yield 2× attempted multimeter checks vs Line group.
B: **Both-loud vs Relay.** Both-loud fails: louder end steals crowd, other empties, cap binds. Chosen: Clock Relay. Agree: :00-:15 North sparse drone, South featured melody; :15-:30 swap; :30 repeat. Crowd drifts to featured end, then roles reverse before far end dies, shuttling crowd back. Example: 8:00 North strums soft chords while South solos; latecomers walk south. 8:15 South drops to chords, North solos; crowd migrates north. Test: tally cases every 10 min Saturday vs both-loud Friday; Relay should show smaller North-South gap and higher total.
C: **Shuffle vs Ledger Loop.** Shuffle risks repeats and lost voices. Chosen: Numbered Sleeves. Day: each tape gets numbered sleeve + matching stub for resident; log number in Unplayed box. Night: play Unplayed in order for 2.5 hours, then 0.5 hour Repeat Request from Yesterday box. After airing, move sleeve to Yesterday box with date; next morning move to Archive wall list. Correction: if night overplayed one batch, next night starts at missed numbers. Example: #42 plays Tuesday, resident sees #42 on door list Wednesday, claims with stub. Test: plant 5 marked tapes; all should appear within week with no number twice before all once.
D: **Gala vs Seasonal Salvage.** Gala: one farewell concert, experts pick relic. Chosen: Four Meetings. Summer Collect: booth on bridge logs crossings, stories. Fall Choose: daily crossers vote which 20 fragments — lamps, rivets, planks — to save. Winter Make: workshops clean and carve names. Spring Place: embed them as new-bridge railing inlay and riverside timeline. Example: commuter Ana nominates green lamp #3; it returns lit on new walkway. Test: survey 50 morning crossers after Fall; if <60% recognize ballot items, replace expert list with commuter nominations.
